label: final copy step of length-9 sequences (sparse, token-dependent)
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, almost entirely in length-9 sequences (98% of mass). 82% of mass is on the last output step (t=17, emitting orig(8)) and 15% on the step before it (t=16). Within that position it is very sparse: only about 1.8% of L=9 final steps fire, so precision is very low. Which ones fire depends weakly on tokens: prev input n/j/u, current input k/j/p/i/a, and output h/i/2 are enriched (up to 14x lift for output h), but no compact token conjunction got above F1 of about 0.24. Never fires in the original phase, at the delimiter, on first occurrences of the input token, or (apart from a handful of tiny activations) in shorter sequences. Magnitudes are tiny (max 0.033). The top activations are all at t=17 or t=16 of L=9.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=2 & out_tok=h (+3.05), L=9 & t=17 (+3.01), prev_tok=n (+2.89), prev_tok=j (+2.44), phase=2 & out_tok=2 (+2.36), phase=2 & out_tok=i (+2.34). Lower it: orig8=- (-2.12), orig5=3 (-1.96), in_tok=0 (-1.69), recall_idx=3 (-1.57).
